show-hn.title: Show HN: FallForge Mint – own a model, with a scorecard anyone can re-run
show-hn.body:
The minted model beat its base model on held-out examples.
On 5 held-out examples that were not in the spec it was given, the minted model scored 4 and its base "llama3.2:1b", given the same inputs without the spec, scored 0. Verdict: BEATS.
This receipt can fail. Do not trust it — re-run it.
Signed with a software key: the issuer could fabricate this — which is exactly why it is re-runnable.
Measured on a GitHub runner: https://github.com/sjgant80-hub/fallforgemint/actions/runs/36431565425
Re-run it yourself: https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/fallforgemint/

Bring one job and a few examples. It mints an Ollama model you run on your own machine, holds some examples out, and scores the minted model against its base. The scorecard is signed, and anyone can re-run it on a clean GitHub runner: an edited number, a borrowed CI link or a result that does not reproduce fails the job. The own-vs-rent calculator says keep renting when renting is cheaper. The mint runs in your browser. MIT.

x-post.body: On held-out examples that were not in its spec, the minted model scored 4/5; its base llama3.2:1b, given no spec, scored 0/5: BEATS. The scorecard is signed, and anyone can re-run it on a clean GitHub runner. A forged one fails. https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/fallforgemint/
